# Repoint the remaining reviewer-stand-in tests off `ticket-quality`

## Context

Epic 87d8 is retiring the `ticket-quality` reviewer prompt. The prompt cannot be
deleted while tests still name it, so its users are repointed slice by slice first.
The previous slice took the two largest files (31 references). This slice takes every
remaining *stand-in* use: a test that needs some packaged reviewer id and happens to
have picked this one.

Seven files hold 25 such references. None of them is testing `ticket-quality` itself:

- `tests/unit/test_prompt_library_writes.py` (8) — `enumerate_library` coverage. Its
  own comment reads "a packaged reviewer", and one assertion checks that a reviewer
  is absent from `enumerate_criteria`.
- `tests/unit/test_prompt_index.py` (7) — `get_prompt` resolution and user-override
  precedence, including an override whose front-matter declares a `dimension`.
- `tests/unit/test_prompts_git_canonical.py` (4) — canonical render metadata and
  missing-variable raising.
- `tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py` (3) — catalog membership and
  `llm.get_prompt` render metadata.
- `tests/interfaces/store/test_agent_op_safeguard.py` (1) — a workflow-document
  fixture naming any prompt in a step.
- `tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py` (1) — catalog membership.
- `tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py` (1) — a workflow-step fixture.

## Approach

Substitute the id `ticket-quality` with `code-quality` and the stem `ticket_quality`
with `code_quality` throughout those seven files. No test is added, deleted, renamed,
or restructured, and no assertion changes meaning.

`code-quality` matches `ticket-quality` on every property these tests depend on,
verified by reading both prompts' front-matter rather than assumed:

- `category: review`, so it is in the reviewer catalog and `get_prompt` resolves it.
- `inputs: reviewer_input` and `outputs: review_result` — identical contract.
- `execution_mode: agentic` — identical.
- The same two template variables, `{{ticket_id}}` and `{{ticket_context}}`, which is
  what `test_prompts_git_canonical.py`'s missing-variable test depends on.
- **No `applies_to` globs.** `security` and `tests` declare them, so either would
  change `select_reviewers` results. `code-quality` declares none, as
  `ticket-quality` does.

`completion-verifier` was rejected: its `outputs` is `completion_verdict`.
`spec-alignment` matches on contract but is the batch spec-scan reviewer.

Two further references are deliberately NOT in this slice, because they are roster
enumerations rather than stand-ins and can only shrink when the prompt is actually
deleted: `tests/unit/test_prompt_front_matter.py:183` (the minimum packaged-id set
that keeps the golden round-trip from passing on nothing) and
`tests/unit/test_prompt_cache_split.py:32` (`_MARKED_PROMPTS`, a parametrize tuple —
removing an entry changes node IDs). Both belong with the prompt's deletion.

## Scope

Verified rather than assumed: the substitution was applied to a clean checkout of
`3b80ff04452` and the six locally-runnable files' 110 tests were run. All 110 passed
with no other edit, and the collected node IDs were byte-identical to the baseline.
`git grep -cF` over the seven files then returned nothing. `ruff check` passed with
no reformatting required.

`tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py` carries the `external` marker, so
it is excluded from `make test` and from CI's gating cell. Its single-line change is
covered by the grep and lint criteria below, not by a test run.

Out of scope, and deliberately untouched: the prompt file
`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ticket_quality.md`, `reviewers/index.json`, the two roster
enumerations named above, `docs/` prose, and the workflow example YAML. The prompt
stays in the catalog after this slice; later slices retire it.

Also out of scope, because each is a frozen or derived artifact rather than a live
reference: `docs/release-notes.md` historical entries, the
`evals/plan-review-gate/runs/*.jsonl` input corpora, and the tracked `.test_durations`
pytest-split timing cache.

`docs/release-notes.md` gains one short entry recording the fixture repoint, with no
change to test count, test names, or behaviour. The entry is additions-only.

## Testing

No new tests. These files are themselves the tests, and they must keep passing
unchanged in count and in name. Their collected node IDs are compared before and
after to prove the slice neither adds nor removes a test.

## Acceptance criteria

Every command below was run against `3b80ff04452` while writing this plan.
`$F8` below names the seven files listed in Context.

- [x] **AC1** `git grep -cF -e 'ticket-quality' -e 'ticket_quality' -- $F8` prints
      nothing and exits 1. Today it prints 8, 7, 4, 3, 1, 1 and 1.
- [x] **AC2** `pytest $F8 -q` (external file omitted, as it cannot run locally) exits
      0 reporting exactly `110 passed`.
- [x] **AC3** `pytest $F8 -q --collect-only | grep '::' | sort` (external file
      omitted) is byte-identical to the same command on `origin/main`. No test name
      contains a reviewer id, so the lists must match exactly.
- [x] **AC4** `git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD` lists exactly those seven files
      plus `docs/release-notes.md`, and no other path.
- [x] **AC5** `ruff check src tests` exits 0 with no output.
- [x] **AC6** `git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD -- docs/release-notes.md` shows a
      non-zero addition count and `0` deletions.
- [x] **AC7** `make verify` exits 0.
